state:
- Evidence handling is exceptional in distinguishing S1 from S2 and supported premises from speculative bridges, but novelty remains unestablished. Check prior teriflunomide–AML and uridine-salvage studies; identify what is new beyond applying established DHODH biology to residual disease.
- The drug–pathway–context–endpoint specification is unusually precise, but baseline uridine incorporation does not establish salvage capacity as the causal sensitivity determinant. Define a demand-adjusted salvage threshold and manipulate uridine transport or UCK activity, testing sensitivity at matched drug exposure and DHODH engagement.
- Genotype-confirmed maturation cannot exclude selective survival of pre-existing mature leukemic cells. Track initially immature malignant cells longitudinally and transplant equal viable malignant-cell inputs after washout to distinguish differentiation-associated loss of propagation from cytotoxic depletion.
